newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka stocks end low as investors await results.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka stocks end low as investors await results.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed soft on Thursday as investors waited on sidelines ahead of interim corporate results, but turnover was boosted by foreign buying of a blue chip, brokers said.
The all share index closed 2.47 points down at 817.53, with price gains nudging declines by 30 to 24. Blue chips Hayleys Ltd fell 10.25 rupees to 260, John Keells Holdings Ltd five to 330.

"The all share index will stay at around these levels until the results come out, which should serve to take the market up to about 900 points by September," said Dihan Dedigama of John Keells Stock Brokers.
A Reuter poll of seven leading Colombo brokers suggested the all share index would rise to an average 878.6 points by end of September and 937.1 by the end of the year.
Turnover on Thursday was 126.97 million rupees, supported by foreign buying of 183,900 shares of Development Finance Corporation, which closed two rupees higher at 310.
